scope: All failed ci.yml runs created on/after 2026-11-09 in the repository failure page (100 of 1083; last item created 2026-10-30). All 17 run jobs pages fetched with per_page=100; no run has over 71 jobs.

root_causes.note: The named scanner treats /artifact/test_peer_configuration_lifetime.py in a pinned checkout sparse-checkout block as a command; fixed by 92597c3d (#150). 919a031 is a later CodeQL inventory merge, not the scanner fix.

test_owned_inputs_survive_and_each_borrowed_input_is_detected: compiler return 1; unittest truncated stderr. 8aadcc89 changes peer_config_device to explicit output storage; descendant waves have only scanner failure.

root_causes.class: installed consumer coverage join missing cancelled partitions
root_causes.note: Each join correctly rejects incomplete partition sets. 80 Swift/Kotlin/Android installed jobs in this scope had runner_id=0, no steps, and completed at creation + 24h (within 1 second). These jobs never executed. Do not weaken the join or represent them as product test failures.
Python distributions, Gradle, Maude, Tamarin and opam assets; no code test began in these failed steps. Existing installers retried; final 504 remained.

root_causes.class: Android API35 16K emulator system_server crashes during startup
root_causes.error: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Cannot access system provider: 'settings' before system providers are installed!
timeline: 19:56:36 system_server PID569 SIGSEGV in system AppSearch protobuf ODEX
19:56:48 adb install cannot access settings provider while PID2474 is restarting
19:56:49 system_server PID2474 SIGSEGV in libart ClassLinker::ResolveMethod
root_causes.current_relevance: Current boot-completed gate still queries only sys.boot_completed and vold.decrypt, identical to the failed source. Actual SDK APK has not been executed. A bounded provider/framework-stability observation before installation could address the observed readiness gap; preserving system crash diagnostics is necessary.
